mainEntity.name: Why is managing online reviews important for multi-location GEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Managing online reviews is critical for multi-location GEO because reviews significantly influence local search rankings and customer decision-making. Search engines prioritize businesses with numerous, recent, and positive reviews, and your overall rating directly impacts local visibility. For each location, strong review profiles build trust and credibility with potential local customers. Actively soliciting and responding to reviews across platforms like Google and Yelp for every branch demonstrates engagement and helps improve local SEO, driving more traffic and conversions to individual stores.
acceptedAnswer.description: Online reviews are critical for multi-location GEO because they boost local search rankings and influence customer decisions, building trust and driving traffic to each branch.
